facts.fact: KRAY 在开罗 Le Méridien 的 Café St. Germain 带着黄色文件夹坐了一个半小时等 VESUVIUS，边等边喝咖啡，对方始终没露面。
facts.anchor: he sat there with his yellow file folder for a good hour and a half, waiting and sipping coffee, but no dice

facts.fact: 服务员给 KRAY 端上 Gorgonzola 三明治配腌黄瓜，以及一杯 2005 年 Jacques-Frédéric Mugnier 的 Nuits-Saint-Georges 勃艮第酒。
facts.anchor: a very tasty Gorgonzola sandwich paired with a pickle and a fine glass of Burgundy, the 2005 Nuits-Saint-Georges by Jacques-Frédéric Mugnier

facts.fact: VESUVIUS 在赴会途中以为发现有人跟踪，于是中止了会面；他确实被跟踪了。
facts.anchor: he thought he spotted surveillance following him, so he aborted. And he was right.

facts.fact: VESUVIUS 已在亚历山大港花四个月发展一名朝鲜线人，带他钓鱼、帮他练网球反手。
facts.anchor: VESUVIUS had been developing a North Korean up in Alexandria for four months, taking him fishing, helping him with his tennis backhand

facts.fact: KRAY 在露天博物馆把带荷鲁斯象形文字的灰色花岗岩碎片塞进袜子，然后系好鞋带。
facts.anchor: then slipped the artifact into his sock and finished tying his shoelace

facts.fact: KRAY 给门卡拉金字塔（三座大金字塔中最小的一座）脚下的一名埃及士兵一把五十皮亚斯特硬币，让他转过头去。
facts.anchor: KRAY slipped a handful of fifty-piastre coins to an Egyptian soldier standing at the foot of the Pyramid of Menkaure, the smallest of the three Great Pyramids

facts.fact: KRAY 在塔顶想着下方平原上的 8276 万埃及人，又掏出袜中的石头，凝视上面 3000 年历史的荷鲁斯像。
facts.anchor: the 82.76 million Egyptians roaming around on the flatlands fathoms below him. He reached down, withdrew a hieroglyph-bearing stone from his sock, and gazed at its 3,000-year-old image of Horus

facts.fact: 埃及人发动革命，把执政三十年的穆巴拉克赶下台。
facts.anchor: give the dynastically minded Mohammad Hosni Mubarak the old yo heave-ho after thirty years of pharaonic rule
